fact: Djibouti Customs says it processed 205,678 declarations in 2023, of which transit declarations were routed to yellow, blue, green and red lanes, with selectivity to be extended to other regimes in 2025.

Djibouti customs (DGDDI) states that from 2 September 2025 free-zone operators and forwarders register and clear IM7 and EX3 declarations in SYDONIAWorld, with customs and stamp fees debited from prepayment accounts.
